authorization: Retain the 600 and audit every added positive

sampling.design: 600 uniformly sampled original positives, retained unchanged, plus every added positive audited (census); not a uniform sample of 601

uniform_sampling.design: uniform without replacement from all known candidate positive labels

note: User-approved mixed sampling design. The original 600 product evidence, positive labels and references are unchanged; every newly positive product has two new blind source-cited readings. The overall conditional bound weights the original-stratum bound by its population share and treats the completely audited new stratum as zero reference errors. This is not the binomial interval for 601 independent random products. Shared model/reference errors and undisclosed facts are not covered; no unconditional physical guarantee is claimed.
